title: Native Higher-Call Time-Reversal Schedule-Duality Audit: Global Sign-Conjugation Invariance, Klein Four-Group Schedule Reduction, and Symmetric-Transpose Time-Reversal Duality

theorems.name: Exact Global Sign-Conjugation Invariance (epsilon, sigma) <-> (-epsilon, -sigma)
theorems.statement: For every k-call schedule (epsilon, sigma) and phase vector y in Z_q^D, |Psi_(-epsilon, -sigma)(y)> = conj(|Psi_(epsilon, sigma)(y)>), so P_(-epsilon, -sigma)(x | y) = P_(epsilon, sigma)(x | y) identically for all outcomes x in {0, ..., D-1}.

theorems.name: Final-Fourier Reflection sigma_k <-> -sigma_k and Klein Four-Group Schedule Quotient
theorems.statement: Flipping sigma_k -> -sigma_k permutes outcomes by modular negation P_(epsilon, (sigma_(1..k-1), -sigma_k))(x | y) = P_(epsilon, sigma)((-x) mod D | y), so the Klein four-group G_4 = {I, iota_1, iota_2, iota_1*iota_2} partitions the 4^k schedules into 4^(k-1) orbits of size 4 with identical E_(epsilon, sigma) and V_HS(epsilon, sigma).

theorems.name: Symmetric-Matrix Transpose Identity and Exact Zero-Outcome Time-Reversal Duality
theorems.statement: For epsilon^rev = (epsilon_k, ..., epsilon_1) and sigma^rev = (sigma_(k-1), ..., sigma_1, sigma_k), complex symmetry of D_y and F_D implies <0_D | Psi_(epsilon, sigma)(y)> = <0_D | Psi_(epsilon^rev, sigma^rev)(y)> and P_(epsilon, sigma)(0 | y) = P_(epsilon^rev, sigma^rev)(0 | y) for all y in Z_q^D.
